intro: Hey, I'm Lucas. I've been building things on the web for 10+ years, currently working as a full-stack software engineer at Index Risk. But there's more to me than code - I write about technology and life, geek out about music on my YouTube channel, and I'm always reading something interesting. Welcome to my corner of the internet.

hero.headline: Full-stack software engineer: React, TypeScript, Go and PostgreSQL. 10+ years shipping production web apps, Toptal top 3%.

workingOn: Shipped the official hotsite for global pop star Pabllo Vittar's PV7 album rollout: about 20,000 fans on launch day, with new campaign phases flipped live from the admin panel and zero redeploys. Wild to build something this many fans saw!
Owning features end to end on Index Risk's underwriting platform, a specialty MGU: design doc, React UI and Go API. Currently building cross-sell.
Revamping MyScrobble.fm with new features I've always dreamed of. Really excited to ship it soon!
Maintaining Carta de Adeus, a fan tribute to Fresno's new album. As a fan of their music myself, it's awesome to build something that might reach lots of people!
